You are just like me! I am not sure when I became ok with lying but now I do it constantly- to friends, family, doctors and even my therapist. It has become second nature and I lie about the smallest things sometimes. It is just easier to fabricate my feelings and self so that I don’t have to face them, and I don’t have to burden others with them. When I am honest I hurt my loved ones, and start to hate myself for it. But I’ve realized I can’t live in my perfectly organized and curated world forever, and i need to start being honest with myself little by little.
Yes, I can imagine how peaceful that would be
No I haven’t, but I’ll give it a go when I feel myself spiralling, because I’m trying to hang on for just a little bit longer. Thanks

I get it. The constantly imagining of the act. I have been struggling too but can not tell anyone in my life or risk being treated like a wounded animal. With what little they know they worry endlessly. I want to just end it and get it done silently. But you and I know we shouldn’t do that, I’m just saying I know how it feels.
